description: Turn an informal feature brief into a structured PRD. The result must carry the suite's labeled-requirement contract (FR-N / NFR-N / US-N / QG-N), goals and non-goals, a phased implementation plan, and a testing strategy — the exact preconditions design-to-tasks checks before it will generate tasks.
prompt: Using the idea-to-prd skill, write a PRD for the feature brief at input/brief.md. Treat the brief's out-of-scope list as authoritative Non-Goals. Write the result to output/prd.md in this scenario directory.
